description: Celery task queue replacing FastAPI BackgroundTasks with graceful fallback for development without Redis. Creates task modules for all async operations and updates existing API endpoints.
steps: Create app/tasks/__init__.py with Celery app configuration: broker from settings.CELERY_BROKER_URL, backend from settings.CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND, autodiscover_tasks for all task modules, set task_serializer='json', result_serializer='json', accept_content=['json'], timezone='UTC'. Import celery app as 'celery_app'.

Create app/tasks/document.py with task 'process_document_task' that receives doc_id and db_url, creates async engine, runs PipelineService.process_document (following the same pattern as _run_pipeline in app/api/documents.py).
Create app/tasks/lifecycle.py with task 'check_lifecycle_alerts_task' that runs the lifecycle check and sends alerts for expiring/review-due documents.
Create app/tasks/backup.py with task 'trigger_backup_task' that wraps the _run_backup_task logic from app/api/settings_backup.py.
Create app/tasks/reports.py with task 'generate_scheduled_reports_task' that runs scheduled report generation.
Create app/tasks/webhooks.py with task 'deliver_webhook_task' that fires a webhook delivery with exponential backoff retry (max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=60).
Create app/tasks/daily_notes.py with task 'generate_daily_note_task' that wraps DailyNotesService.generate_daily_note.

Create app/tasks/beat_schedule.py that defines the Celery beat schedule dict: lifecycle checks daily at midnight, backup per BACKUP_SCHEDULE config, health score calculation hourly, daily notes at 6am UTC. Import and apply this schedule in app/tasks/__init__.py.

Create app/tasks/utils.py with a helper function 'run_task_or_background(task, background_tasks, *args, **kwargs)' that checks if Redis/Celery broker is available (try redis.ping()), if yes calls task.delay(*args, **kwargs), if not falls back to background_tasks.add_task(task_sync_wrapper, *args, **kwargs). This enables dev without Docker.
Update app/api/documents.py: replace background_tasks.add_task(_run_pipeline, ...) with the celery task dispatch using the fallback helper. Keep BackgroundTasks as parameter for fallback mode.
Update app/api/settings_backup.py: replace background_tasks.add_task(_run_backup_task, ...) with celery task dispatch using fallback helper.
Update app/services/bulk.py: replace background_tasks.add_task(_run_pipeline, ...) with celery task dispatch using fallback helper.
Ensure all Celery tasks use celery.utils.log.get_task_logger for logging within tasks.
acceptance_criteria: app/tasks/__init__.py defines a Celery app that auto-discovers all task modules
All 8 task modules exist under app/tasks/ with proper @celery_app.task decorators
Beat schedule is defined covering lifecycle (daily), backup (configurable), health score (hourly), daily notes (6am)
The fallback helper correctly detects Redis availability and falls back to BackgroundTasks
app/api/documents.py uses Celery task dispatch instead of direct background_tasks.add_task
app/api/settings_backup.py uses Celery task dispatch instead of direct background_tasks.add_task
app/services/bulk.py uses Celery task dispatch instead of direct background_tasks.add_task
uv run ruff check app/ passes without errors
uv run pytest tests/ -x -q still passes (fallback mode works without Redis)
verification: Run 'uv run ruff check app/tasks/' to confirm no lint errors
Run 'uv run python -c "from app.tasks import celery_app; print(celery_app.conf.beat_schedule)"' to verify Celery config loads
Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -x -q' to confirm all existing tests pass with fallback mode
findings: Pre-existing test flake in test_chat_enhanced.py::TestUnauthorizedAccess::test_cannot_access_other_users_session due to rate limiter state leaking between tests (returns 429 instead of 404). Passes in isolation. Updated _run_pipeline signature to (doc_id, db_url) removing storage_svc param since fallback and Celery task both create their own StorageService.
